(function(){try{ // SOLO ONLY, deliberately. The three body.solo-app rules below hold for as // long as the page IS solo — and there is exactly one path that ends that: // Invite-from-solo turns this page into an app ROOM in place. That path must // therefore clear BOTH copies, and it does (inviteFromSolo, far below) — // clearing only the body one left this mirror hiding the meeting bar, the // grid and the feed forever, so a call in such a room showed nothing. The // app-room rules are NOT mirrored at all: an app-pinned room is audio-only // (0.9.13: its grid and filmstrip never show, call-on or not — the tiles // would be blank camera-off boxes under the app), so there is nothing to // un-hide and no reason to touch for them.
